data.one_liner: Crop any widget or image in Flutter using 100% pure Dart code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Crop widget that allows users to crop any widget or image within Flutter apps. Supports scaling, rotation, and custom offsets without depending on native platform APIs.
use_when: You need to let users crop images or custom widgets within a Flutter application.
You want a pure Dart cropping solution that supports Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop.
avoid_when: You only need heavy-duty native image manipulation outside of the widget tree.
You require a full-featured photo gallery and editing suite out of the box.
strengths: 100% pure Dart implementation with no native platform dependencies.
Supports cropping any arbitrary widget, not just images.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop.
weaknesses: Limited to what can be rendered within a Flutter widget tree.
Does not include advanced built-in image filters or comprehensive editing suites.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need low-level image processing and manipulation purely in Dart without relying on UI widgets.
